none: PAS LANCUM-0382A5: Roman copper alloy radiate copy of Divus Claudius AD 270 (Reece Period 13)
contea di ritrovamento: Hampshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Roman copper alloy radiate copy of Divus Claudius dating to AD 270 (Reece Period 13). Reverse type CONSECRATIO Eagle. Cf RIC 5 (Claudius II), 265. Obverse inscription would be [IMP CLAVDIVS AVG] and the reverse inscription is [CONSEC]RATIO. The coin is damaged. The diameter is 17mm, and the weight is 1.47g
